title: openai: /v1/chat.completions parity - params/roles/stop/logprobs/formatting + streaming stability
author: Avery Chen
description: Motivation: Bring Redwood's OpenAI compatibility layer for /v1/chat.completions to parity with common client expectations. This PR addresses parameter mapping (temperature, top_p, n, presence_penalty, frequency_penalty), correct handling of roles (system/user/assistant + role normalization), support for stop sequences and logprobs in non-streaming and streaming modes, structured response formatting alignment, and several streaming stability fixes required to avoid dropped tokens and duplicate deltas. Changes are focused on the OpenAI compatibility handler, streaming manager, and the public examples/docs. Checklist: - [x] Map OpenAI params to internal API and validate edge cases - [x] Implement logprobs support and ensure stable token indices across streaming and final output - [x] Ensure stop sequence handling matches OpenAI semantics (multiple stops, partial matches mid-token) - [x] Make streaming delta encoder idempotent to avoid duplicate tokens on reconnect/retry - [x] Add structured output normalization to match function/tool-calling expectations - [x] Add unit + integration + e2e tests covering parity cases - [x] Update docs and examples (Python/TS) - [x] Run perf/latency regression checks Summary of work: - parameter layer: added explicit mapping and validation for temperature/top_p/n/stop/logprobs/echo/presence_penalty/frequency_penalty to avoid subtle defaults and mismatches with OpenAI clients - roles: normalized role names and implemented strict position handling for initial system messages; fixes issues where system messages were previously dropped when proxied through chat endpoints - logprobs: plumbed logprobs support through the tokenizer + scoring path; when requested, we now return token-level logprob arrays in final response and streaming with consistent token indices - streaming: fixed race in stream_manager that could emit duplicate start tokens after reconnect; added tests for resume semantics and idempotent delta replay - structured output & function/tool calling: adjusted the compatibility layer to respect function_call hints and emit structured JSON in the same shape as OpenAI (including name and arguments fields) - docs/examples: updated openai compatibility reference, added Python and TS quickstarts showing new params and function-calling examples Risk/compatibility notes: - This changes the OpenAI compat contract surface; we tried to maintain backwards compatibility but recommend teams using raw internal APIs to prefer the new compat layer for OpenAI clients. - Performance: small CPU cost for logprobs when requested; disabled by default unless logprobs param is set. Testing: added ~40 unit tests and 6 e2e scenarios validating streaming resume, stop handling, and function-calling structured outputs. Linked Linear: ENG-5227 (compat parity), ENG-5341 (streaming stability).

release_notes: OpenAI /v1/chat.completions compatibility: support for full param set (temperature, top_p, n, stop, logprobs), improved roles handling, streaming stability fixes, and improved structured output/function-calling parity. Backward-compatible but opt-in logprobs due to CPU cost.
